subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS make Chat the sole conversational destination, remove the standalone Talk tab, and retain `talk` and `voice` launch inputs only as aliases into Chat?
rationale: This replaces a shipped navigation and realtime-voice workflow; implementation quality and tests cannot decide whether that product direction should supersede the separate Talk surface.

options.title: Approve Unified Chat
options.body: Accept Chat as the sole conversational destination, retain legacy launch aliases, and require branch cleanup and final proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Talk Separate
options.body: Retain the standalone Talk destination and narrow the PR to ownership and Live Activity safety improvements.

options.title: Pilot Without Removal
options.body: Introduce the unified composer while keeping Talk reachable until the replacement workflow has broader evaluation.

recommendation.title: Approve Unified Chat
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the sole conversational destination, retain legacy launch aliases, and require branch cleanup and final proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged iOS UI and Talk work connects this person closely to the navigation and runtime boundary being replaced.
